![medium](https://www.gstatic.com/codereviewagent/medium-priority.svg)

When processing collections of assets or inputs, we should normalize the input using an array helper (e.g., `asArray`) and filter out non-record entries before mapping or flat-mapping over them to prevent TypeErrors on null, undefined, or non-array inputs. Please filter `sourceArtifacts` with `isRecord` before mapping over it.

```suggestion
function dependencyArtifactsOk(status, sourceArtifacts, inputErrors) {
  const sourceArtifactRoles = new Set(asArray(sourceArtifacts).filter(isRecord).map((artifact) => artifact?.role));
```

Please filter `quality_check_definitions` with `isRecord` before mapping over it.

```suggestion
function qualityChecksDeclared(manifest) {
  return exactArray(asArray(manifest?.quality_check_definitions).filter(isRecord).map((definition) => definition?.id), QUALITY_CHECK_IDS)
```

Fixed in baeea3507: per-record `quality_checks` are now filtered through `asArray(...).filter(isRecord)` in both promotion validation and required-check-id validation.
Fixed in baeea3507: `dependencyArtifactsOk` now normalizes `sourceArtifacts` with `asArray(...).filter(isRecord)` before mapping roles.
Fixed in baeea3507: `qualityChecksDeclared` now filters `quality_check_definitions` through `asArray(...).filter(isRecord)` before mapping and validating fields.

Fixed in baeea3507: the validator now emits explicit `quality_check_definitions_invalid_type` and `quality_blocked_reason_codes_invalid_type` diagnostics, with regression coverage in the malformed-array test.
Fixed in baeea3507: added regression coverage for null, undefined, string, numeric, and array manifest inputs returning fail-closed `manifest_record_required`.
